description: B2 (mul, 4-query bilinear vote) and B3 (lin, 2-query BLR vote); see code/exp_tasks.py

config.tie_rule: a tie for first place is a failure
config.unit: training run (6 mul runs, 9 lin runs)
config.eps_all_definition: largest eps among a run's snapshots with every input correctable
config.eps_some_definition: smallest eps among a run's snapshots with some input not correctable

law_fit.two_rate_law: 1/q + (1-1/q) E[lam_generic^(4-n) lam_special^n], n = number of special cells among the four query points (exact distribution above)

representatives.rule: mul snapshot with eps closest to the target (ties: smallest id), over all 150
representatives.note: plain model error on the non-trivial inputs is eps_generic; one vote (k = 1) fails with probability 1 - pc_meas

vs_iid_baseline.interpolation_axis: mean realised eps of the i.i.d. fields

lin.law_identity_note: For the 2-query vote, mean_x T_x(0) = sum_h p_h^2 exactly (p_h = share of inputs with error value h), so the input-averaged per-vote correctness depends only on the histogram of error values, not on where the errors sit; it equals the law iff the wrong values are equally frequent.  Checked to 1e-12 for all 108 models (pc_identity_from_histogram).  Spatial coherence shows only in the spread of T_x(0) over inputs (t0_sd, t0_min, margin_min).

extraction.rule: self-correct M on the four unit vectors with k = 129 BLR votes each (independent randomness); w is recovered iff all four pluralities are correct and untied; p_recover_w_exact = prod_i (1 - delta_129(e_i)) from the exact channel

vs_iid_baseline.interpolation_axis: mean realised eps of the i.i.d. fields

iid_baseline_lin.construction: U ~ Uniform(0,1)^|G|, V ~ Uniform{1..q-1}^|G|; E_eps = V where U < eps else 0 (nested in eps)

iid_baseline_mul.construction: U ~ Uniform(0,1)^|G|, V ~ Uniform{1..q-1}^|G|; E_eps = V where U < eps else 0 (nested in eps)
iid_baseline_mul.note: i.i.d. errors on all 961 cells, including the special cells a = 0 or b = 0; 4-query bilinear vote; correctable fraction over the 900 generic inputs
